name: day22-transformer-retrieval-golden-set
description: Five manually labelled retrieval cases against the sample Transformers and Retrieval-Augmented Generation chunks.

cases.query: What roles do queries, keys, and values play in self-attention?
How does self-attention capture relationships between words that are far apart?
Why is positional information added when tokens already have embeddings?
Why can chunking a long document improve retrieval quality?
What trade-offs should I consider when choosing chunk size and overlap?
